servicesOverview.heading: Core Service Areas
servicesOverview.subtitle: End-to-end financial services designed for EU multi-jurisdiction operations.

whyMMK.heading: Multi-jurisdiction expertise, single point of contact
whyMMK.body: Managing financial obligations across multiple EU countries is complex. Regulations differ, languages differ, deadlines differ. MMK Services was built to handle exactly this complexity — giving you a single, dedicated advisory team that understands Slovak, Dutch, and German requirements at the same depth a local firm would, but with the coordination and consistency only a multi-jurisdiction specialist can provide.
features: Multi-jurisdiction GAAP expertise across 3 EU countries
IFRS-compliant statements for cross-border group structures
Dedicated account manager with local-language support
Strict GDPR-compliant data handling and confidentiality

ctaBanner.heading: Simplify your EU financial compliance
ctaBanner.subtitle: Let us handle the complexity across borders. One team, three countries, full compliance.

servicesPage.heading: Our Services
servicesPage.subtitle: Specialised accounting, audit, and tax advisory for EU multi-jurisdiction businesses — built around your operational reality.
servicesPage.intro: Each service is delivered by specialists with deep in-country expertise, ensuring you meet local requirements without the overhead of managing multiple local firms.
servicesPage.notSureHeading: Not sure which service fits your needs?
servicesPage.notSureBody: Send us a short note about your business structure and jurisdictions — we will come back with a tailored recommendation within one business day.

accounting.title: Accounting & Bookkeeping
accounting.description: Comprehensive bookkeeping compliant with local GAAP standards across all operating jurisdictions.
accounting.fullDescription: Our accounting and bookkeeping services provide end-to-end financial record management, ensuring full compliance with local GAAP standards in Slovakia, Netherlands, and Germany. We handle chart of accounts setup, monthly closings, bank reconciliations, and financial statement preparation — giving you a clean, audit-ready ledger at every reporting date.

consolidated-reporting.title: Consolidated Reporting
consolidated-reporting.description: Group consolidation and IFRS-compliant financial statements for multi-entity EU structures.
consolidated-reporting.fullDescription: We prepare consolidated financial statements under IFRS and local GAAP for complex group structures. Our team manages intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, and minority interest calculations, delivering clear, auditor-ready consolidation packages that meet EU regulatory expectations.

audit.title: Audit & Assurance
audit.description: Audit workpaper preparation, statutory audit support, and assurance services for EU entities.
audit.fullDescription: We support statutory audit processes by preparing comprehensive audit workpapers, detailed documentation packages, and facilitating auditor requests. Our assurance services extend to internal control reviews and agreed-upon procedures, providing confidence in the quality and reliability of your financial reporting.

tax.title: Tax Filings (VAT/CIT)
tax.description: VAT returns, corporate income tax filings, and cross-border tax compliance across SK, NL, and DE.
tax.fullDescription: We manage VAT registration, periodic returns, and corporate income tax filings across all three jurisdictions. Our tax team stays current with local legislative changes, ensuring timely and accurate submissions that minimise compliance risk and avoid penalties. We also advise on cross-border transfer pricing documentation.

payroll.title: Payroll Administration
payroll.description: End-to-end payroll processing, social security contributions, and employment tax compliance.
payroll.fullDescription: Our payroll services cover gross-to-net calculations, statutory deductions, social and health insurance contributions, and payslip generation. We ensure full compliance with local labour law, handle all payroll-related monthly filings, and provide clear payroll reports for management review.

due-diligence.title: Due Diligence Support
due-diligence.description: Financial due diligence for M&A transactions, investor reporting, and cross-border restructuring.
due-diligence.fullDescription: We provide financial due diligence support for acquisitions, investments, and corporate restructuring transactions. Our deliverables include quality of earnings analysis, normalised EBITDA bridges, working capital assessments, and red-flag reports — all tailored to the expectations of investors, lenders, and transaction advisors.

aboutPage.heading: About MMK Services
aboutPage.subtitle: A specialist EU financial advisory firm built on precision, discretion, and cross-border expertise.
aboutPage.whoHeading: Built for the complexity of EU operations
aboutPage.body1: MMK Services was founded to fill a specific gap: growing European businesses need accounting and advisory teams that understand the regulatory environments of multiple jurisdictions across Europe.
aboutPage.body2: We operate across Slovakia, the Netherlands, and Germany, combining deep local expertise with the coordination of a single, integrated team. Our clients range from privately held companies expanding across Europe to international groups with EU holding structures.
aboutPage.body3: We speak the language of each jurisdiction — literally and regulatorily — and we handle the compliance burden so you can focus on running your business.
aboutPage.glanceStandardsValue: Slovak GAAP · NL GAAP · HGB · IFRS
aboutPage.missionQuote: To remove the friction of EU multi-jurisdiction compliance, so that every client can operate across borders with the same confidence as they do at home.
aboutPage.workBody: Whether you are setting up a new EU entity or need ongoing advisory support, we are ready to help.

values.title: Precision
values.description: We deliver meticulous, error-free work — because in accounting, every decimal matters and every deadline is a commitment.

values.title: Confidentiality

values.title: Responsiveness
values.description: Timely, clear communication across time zones and jurisdictions — you always have a single point of contact and a direct answer.
